split.note: Rows of each CSV are kept in file order (CICFlowMeter emits flows in start-time order). Within each file and family, the first 70% of that family's rows become train, the next 15% validation and the last 15% test, so every family's test rows come after its train rows in time. A plain positional split was rejected in the smoke test because families whose attack window ends early (web, DoS Hulk) had no or few test rows. Test is retained completely.

label_coverage.rule: A family is trained and scored only if its train split has at least max(budgets) rows and its test split at least one row; other families are excluded from both training and macro-F1 and listed in label_coverage.json.

oracle_ceiling.definition: On the test split, predict the majority family of each identical-feature group; its macro-F1 is the deterministic-classifier ceiling
oracle_ceiling.note: Only classes included by the coverage rule are scored; macro over those classes.
